fixes.where: how-we-work.html #faq (add a seventh <details> after "Where do you work?")
fixes.what:
Add: What does it cost?

Every proposal is priced to the events, days and staffing it covers. Full planning and wedding-day coordination are quoted separately, and the price sits on the first page of the proposal, before anything is booked. If you have a budget in mind, say so in the form and we tell you plainly what it covers.
fixes.why: Parents who pay ask the price first; a site that never says the word cost reads as expensive and evasive.
